notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{W}
description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{W}.
Cast Skyblade's Boon by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Skyblade's Boon spell.
Activate Skyblade's Boon by paying {2}{W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
